chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said:

Regarding a contracted slave girl whom her master copulates with and she becomes pregnant, he said: 'A dower similar to hers is returned to her, and she works to pay off her price. If she is unable (to pay), then she is from the mothers of the children (ummahat al-awlad).'

key_terms.أُمَّهَاتِ الْأَوْلَادِ: Mothers of the children; a status where a slave woman is freed upon her master's death upon the birth of his child.
key_terms.مُكَاتَبَةٍ: A slave who has a contract with their master to buy freedom by paying a set amount over time.
key_terms.يَطَؤُهَا: Copulates with / has sexual intercourse with.

ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling for a contracted slave girl who becomes pregnant by her master?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the financial and legal transition of a *mukattabah* (slave woman paying for her freedom) who conceives by her master, ensuring she receives a dower equivalent to free women while her manumission debt is offset by her valuation. The hadith highlights the practical mechanism of converting her status to *ummahat al-walad* if she cannot immediately settle the balance, guaranteeing her eventual manumission upon the master's death and the freedom of her offspring, a key concept in Shia jurisprudence regarding slave emancipation.
